connector.name: MCP by Coinlooter
connector.registryDescription: PayFlowAgent suite: token intel, DeFi, enrich, Base trust (x402).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package payflowagent-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the coinlooter account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: X402_BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Private key of a dedicated payer wallet (Base, USDC) used to auto-pay x402 calls. Without it, only free tools work.

env.name: PAYFLOWAGENT_API_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the nad.fun API (default https://nad.payflowagent.net).

env.name: PAYFLOWAGENT_DATAFEED_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the Datafeed API (default https://data.payflowagent.net).

env.name: PAYFLOWAGENT_ENRICH_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the Enrich API (default https://enrich.payflowagent.net).

env.name: PAYFLOWAGENT_TRUST_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the Trust API (default https://trust.payflowagent.net).

env.name: X402_BUYER_RPC
env.description: Optional payment RPC endpoint (Base mainnet by default).
